findings.text: the manifest fills the wait block while status is complete: wait_condition reads 'coordinator adjudication of the exact-support deficit cause and the two lead decisions it raises ...; no further work is pending from this node', and wait_probe, wait_terminal and resume_brief each carry an 'n/a' note. The contract reserves the wait block for an external condition the worker is actually holding, and states it is never a note about where the work stands. The lines are inert on a complete run (a resume sweep keys on status: waiting), but they put non-wait prose in a field whose shape is contractual, and a reader who takes wait_condition at face value would look for an outstanding wait that does not exist.

bank-overflow-diagnostic.log is listed under negative_control_log but is a diagnostic rather than a control: its first line is 'use_linear_moments True' rather than a declared mutation verbatim, and one log reports both the healthy clip fields (135/135 finite) and the NaN exact current. Its value as a control is real -- it shows the recorder sees a finite clip before the current is reported unavailable, and the seed state is the non-overflowing counterpart -- and the node's negative_control_note explains the split. The shape is what a reader should not mis-take: a negative-control log is normally a red log whose first line restates the mutation, and this one is neither red nor mutation-led.

the report traces the partition with its own _probe instead of the census's _partition_probe, and records the latter as broken at HEAD under follow_ons. I confirmed the shape by reading both: the census probe (benchmarks/unit_amplitude_current_census.py line 299) slices the state to operator.physical_node_number before operator._fixed_design_read, while the node's probe (build_report.py line 157) passes the whole state, and the referenced error string 'own-node null census requires the direct sampling flux values' exists at three sites in nova/. The claim is therefore corroborated by code reading, but the node did not run the census's own probe to show the refusal, so the failure that motivates the workaround is asserted rather than exhibited. It is outside the node's write scope and correctly left unfixed.

justifications.durability: three commits land the deliverable in the assigned worktree -- 71209bff0 (the instrument), b7b7e097f (the plan landing record) and e2b4f2f6c (the run and bank receipts) -- each with a conventional subject and a non-empty body and no AI trailer. The cumulative evidence anchor is a pure append: the diff against the base revision deletes zero lines, and the plan's plan-version/plan-modified meta lines are untouched. The figure is committed as both PNG and SVG; the worktree is clean after my checks. Durability loses a point only for the headerless diagnostic log noted above.
justifications.evidence: I reproduced the mechanism rather than trusting the prose. nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py::_cell_banked_current_moments (definition line 343) integrates the whole-cell branch with cut_cell_capacity=1 at lines 369 and 396, and fails closed at line 419 with jnp.where(cut_count > capacity, jnp.nan, value); nova/equilibrium/clip_quadrature.py::_flux_selected_current_moments (definition line 885) calls back in with boundary_reduction=True at line 929, and the same overflow -> NaN guard sits at lines 816-819. The receipt reproduces the two states exactly: the run.log reads seed {empty-no-vertex-inside-level: 35, shrunk-partial-polygon: 8} / terminal {exact-current-undefined-bank-overflow: 43} / EXACT_SUPPORT_REPORT_EXIT=0, and report.md's bank table shows the whole-cell branch row reading capacity=1, boundary-reduction=True, cut_count=0, overflow=False at the seed against cut_count=2, overflow=True at the terminal -- the single overflowing call the report names. The lane receipt in report.json is one all_debug SLURM job (execution slurm, partition all_debug, jax_platform cpu, jax_enable_x64 True, job_id 1276168, tmpdir /tmp). The instrument is shown to see a healthy state before the absence is reported: the same bank recorder reads the seed's exact current as finite (0.1892 MA) and the seed's whole-cell call as non-overflowing. Evidence loses a little because the diagnostic log carries no revision/tree/command header, so its HEAD claim is not self-evidencing from the log.
justifications.fit: no plan, phase, sprint or followup identifier appears in the node's own new source: its instrument is named for the mechanism (build_report.py, _probe, the two states seed and terminal) and the two named causes are mechanism prose (empty-no-vertex-inside-level, shrunk-partial-polygon, exact-current-undefined-bank-overflow), not stage or ticket labels. The plan edit is a landing record that explicitly leaves the section, gate and driving followup open, which the worker's own contract requires it to do; it does not close the node. The change sits in the report/figure lane the plan assigns §6 to and touches no source outside its declared scope.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the stated goal -- a per-cut-cell report at HEAD names the geometric cause of the exact-mode current deficit on the weak 110-requested (135-realised) row -- is delivered and independently reproduced. report.json/report.md carry one row per cut cell at both fixed states with the analytic, chord and exact current, the clipped polygon area per mode, the cell-vertex signed flux against the boundary level and a named cause; every one of the eight named cells [2, 35, 75, 89, 114, 126, 128, 134] carries a cause at both states; the totals are set against the analytic 16.314569 MA (target 16.314773 MA); nothing under nova/ changed. The named cause is not a geometry zero and the report says so with the receipt behind it: at the terminal state the traced clip is finite 135/135 (area, full_area, both area moments, contour_area, included, vertex_count, support_vertices 42660/42660) with refused_cell_count 4 and vertex_capacity 158, while the exact cell current is finite 0/135. I read the code mechanism myself and it is exactly what the report claims.
justifications.scope_discipline: the change touches exactly the declared write paths -- the exact-support-deficit figure directory (build_report.py, report.json, report.md, the PNG/SVG pair, run.log, bank-overflow-diagnostic.log), the §6 landing record in docs/plans/cut-cell-current-attribution.html and the evidence anchor in docs/evidence/archive/cut-cell-current-attribution-landed.html -- and nothing else; the diff against the base revision contains no nova/ path at all and no peer node's path. git status in the worktree is clean and no branch was created or pushed. The one defect the node surfaced on the census instrument is reported under follow_ons rather than fixed, which is what the report-only scope requires.
